svg.text: A: retain 48 x 44 mm, four nonrectangular mounting holes
Read-only #121 geometry; proposal only. Absolute XY (mm), top view, X right / Y down.
Green: proposed NPTH 2.2 / keepout 5.0. Red: existing traces intersecting the proposed keepouts.
Orange F.Cu / purple In2.Cu / blue B.Cu. Gray: actual courtyards; dashed boxes: provisional service areas.
In1 GND fill omitted. All four A holes intersect the saved GND fill; all-layer keepouts and refill required in Stage 2.
Body/height, screw tolerance, insertion load and case fit require Stage 2 verification. No CAD has been changed.
